groups.name: diatom.api
groups.description: API configuration for the AI model.

properties.name: diatom.api.key
properties.description: API key for AI model authentication.

properties.name: diatom.api.base-url
properties.description: API base URL for the AI service.

properties.name: diatom.api.endpoint
properties.description: API endpoint path override (e.g., /anthropic).

properties.name: diatom.api.model
properties.description: AI model name (e.g., gpt-4, claude-3, deepseek-v4-flash).

properties.name: diatom.api.format
properties.description: API format: auto (default), openai, anthropic, or responses.

properties.name: diatom.api.max-tokens
properties.description: Maximum tokens for AI model response.

properties.name: diatom.agent.language
properties.description: Agent language: en (English) or zh (Chinese).

properties.name: diatom.app.workspace-dir
properties.description: Workspace directory for file operations.

properties.name: diatom.app.user-agent
properties.description: Custom User-Agent header for API requests (e.g., "Diatom-CLI/1.0.0 (IntelliJ IDEA)"). Defaults to "Diatom-CLI/<version>".

properties.name: diatom.agent.max-steps
properties.description: Maximum steps for agent before returning control.

properties.name: diatom.command.sandbox-mode
properties.description: Command sandbox mode: whitelist or none.

properties.name: diatom.command.whitelist
properties.description: List of allowed shell commands.

properties.name: diatom.command.timeout
properties.description: Command execution timeout in seconds.

properties.name: diatom.core.upgrade-enabled
properties.description: Enable automatic core version check on startup.

properties.name: diatom.core.upgrade-policy
properties.description: Core upgrade policy: prompt, auto, or disable.

properties.name: diatom.gateway.url
properties.description: Gateway URL for the Worker to connect to (e.g., http://192.168.1.10:8080). Synced to System.getProperty('gateway.url').

properties.name: diatom.gateway.ssl-enabled
properties.description: Enable HTTPS for the internal management HTTP server.

properties.name: diatom.gateway.ssl-keystore-path
properties.description: Path to certificate/keystore file. Auto-detected: .crt/.pem → PEM, .jks → JKS, .p12/.pfx → PKCS12.

properties.name: diatom.gateway.ssl-keystore-password
properties.description: Keystore password.

properties.name: diatom.gateway.ssl-key-password
properties.description: Key password (defaults to keystore-password if not set).

properties.name: diatom.gateway.ssl-keystore-password-file
properties.description: Path to file containing keystore password (more secure than inline password).

properties.name: diatom.gateway.ssl-key-password-file
properties.description: Path to file containing key password (more secure than inline password).

properties.name: diatom.gateway.ssl-keystore-key
properties.description: Path to PEM private key file (.key). Required when ssl-keystore-path points to a .crt/.pem file.
